entries.zh: 把棕榈叶纤维梳理成绞（备编织、纺织之用）〔原件此条释义存疑〕
entries.en: to work or dress palm-leaf fibre into a hank, for plaiting or weaving [gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 音写 gue-sy 与 H 栏「經/系」的读法不合，hufeda 当为 husada（一绞线），只能据西语词头与汉字推释。

entries.zh: 马夫；随马侍从（跟班、仆役）
entries.en: groom; footman, lackey (servant attending on foot)

entries.zh: 执鞭随镫（马夫随侍马旁的职役）
entries.en: to hold the whip and follow at the stirrup (the duty of a lacayo)

entries.zh: 绅带（束腰的大带）〔音写栏残缺错乱，词头义不明，存疑〕
entries.en: sash, waist-band (broad girdle of official dress) [uncertain]
entries.notes: M 栏 liū-la-co-cāi… 错乱不可解，H 仅一字「紳」，lacada 或即 lazada（带结），不足以定夺。

entries.zh: 冠缨、系帽的丝带〔第二字疑为「緞/綖」之讹，释义存疑〕
entries.en: cap-string, hat cord with its hanging ends [second character corrupt]
entries.notes: H 作「纓 誕」，「誕」于义无取，疑为緞/綖之讹，音写 tỹ-tān 亦不能自证。

entries.zh: 右边；大边（与「细边/左边」相对）
entries.en: the right side; the “big side” (opposed to the left)

entries.zh: 左边；细边（小边，与「大边/右边」相对）
门闩〔字形与音写不合，词头疑为 estar al lado（在旁），释义存疑〕
entries.en: door-bolt, bar [uncertain: headword reads “estar al lado”]
entries.notes: H 栏疑作「閂/閃」而音写作 cuān，音形不能相应；西语 eſtarael lado 亦与门闩义不贴。

entries.en: roadside, the side of the road
slanting, tilted, leaning to one side
hillside, mountain slope; the side of a hill
